name: guardrails
description: Habits worth enforcing: tools the jail refuses in favour of a better one. Opt in by adding "guardrails" to packs.

contributes.message: grep's recursive mode is blocked. Use ripgrep (rg) for recursive searches; pipe filters and single-file greps pass through.
find is blocked to prevent unintended recursive searches. Use fd for a faster, more intuitive alternative.
